name: Caps
summary: The fleet quota Caps already tracks, on the shelf
description: Caps reads /Users/lee/CC/Work/LFI/_ Operations/menubar-snapshot.json, the same file Caps' menu-bar app and its Bartender line read, plus Codex's own session logs. It shows the fleet percentage as a small ring beside the notch, and a shelf card with two lines per account: name, 5-hour use and 7-day use, then a bar with the backlog cap as a tick. Hover an account for its cap in words and its reset times. A short banner drops from the notch when an account runs out or comes back, a budget hold lifts, or a 5-hour window passes 90%. Read-only, local files, no network, refreshed about once a minute.
